LDS Apologetics — The Answers Are Better Than the Questions

The Restored Gospel is true, the attacks on it are answerable, and this is where the answers live.

Why This Site Exists

The attacks on the Restored Gospel are real. They are organized, they are rehearsed, and they are aimed at members who have not been given the tools to answer them. The stakes are eternal. And the evidence in favor of the truth is overwhelming.

The critics deserve a real answer. The wavering member deserves a real answer. This is where they get it.

This site does not ask critics to be patient with the faith. It asks the faith to be patient with nothing. Every objection is answered directly — not deflected, not minimized, not softened into comfortable ambiguity. Answered.

What Is Covered Here

The articles on this site address the arguments that shake faith — the ones circulating in anti-LDS forums, in evangelical debates, in the quiet doubts of members who heard something they couldn’t answer. The topics include:

  • Priesthood authority — who has it, what it is, why it matters, and why Protestant claims to authority fail
  • Salvation and exaltation — what the Gospel of Jesus Christ actually teaches, and where Protestant theology falls short
  • Scripture — the Book of Mormon, the Book of Abraham, the Bible as it is and as it has been misread
  • History and doctrine — Joseph Smith, the Great Apostasy, the Restoration, and every objection that follows
  • The covenants — Abraham’s promise, eternal families, and the theology no other tradition can fulfill

Each article is built on scripture, logic, and the historical record. Not on sentiment. Not on “the Church’s position.” On what Christ said, what the apostles wrote, and what the Restoration recovered.

Verdicts, Not Meditations

Every article on this site ends with a verdict. Not “some people believe.” Not “both sides have merit.” A verdict — stated, proved, closed.

This is not arrogance. It is what truth demands. The Gospel of Jesus Christ is either true or it is not. The evidence either supports it or it does not. This site holds that the Gospel is true and that the evidence is overwhelming — and every page here is written from that conviction.

If your faith has been shaken by a well-rehearsed objection, the answer is here. If you came here with a genuine question, you will find a genuine answer — direct, documented, unhedged. And if you came here with an attack prepared, you will find it has already been answered.

The truth can withstand the scrutiny. It always could. This site exists to prove it.
